title: Overquqed
tagline: A cooperative quantum kitchen: prepare quantum states and serve them before they decohere.
description: You and a friend run the ancilla kitchen of a fault-tolerant quantum computer. Guests, personified error-correcting codes and protocols, order quantum states like |+>, Bell pairs and GHZ. Pull fresh qubits from the Dilution Fridge, run them through kitchen appliances that are really quantum gates, and serve them before they decohere. A tutorial and three kitchens, for 2 players in co-op, or alone swapping between the chefs.

keyboard.p1: W A S D to walk, B to pick up and serve, V to use a station, C to swap chef, Space to pause
keyboard.p2: Arrows to walk, L to pick up and serve, K to use a station, Enter to pause

how_to_play: Guests order quantum states, like |+> or |1>.
Take a qubit from the fridge, change it with the gate machines and serve it before the guest walks out.
A picks up, puts down and serves; B works the station in front of you.
Playing alone? Y swaps between the two chefs.
Start (Space or Enter) pauses the game.
